lesson.title: Telford Hall Episode 1
lesson.title_ar: القسم الأدبي (3): قصة تيلفورد هول — الحلقة 1: وصول أحمد إلى نورتون وبداية الدراسة

lines: [Complete two-column story page available offline in assets/ref/pb_p053.webp; structured episode summary & verbatim cue anchors below for WB Arts 3 A–E:]

Part 1 (Arrival on the train): Ahmed Hassan Al-Hadrami glanced at his new watch (a present from his parents), 15 minutes from Norton College in the North of England for a three-year course in town planning. Seeing grey skies and streams of rain running down the window glass, he hoped the weather wasn't always like this.

Part 2 (Telford Hall & Dining Room): Ahmed dragged 'his two large suitcase' into Telford Hall, where silver-haired receptionist Mrs Dale placed him in room 123 (1st floor) and called tall, fair-haired second-year engineering student Derek Barker to carry his cases before dinner in 5 minutes. At dinner, Ahmed asked about 'Shepherd's pie' (meat and onions covered with mashed potatoes), frowned to check what kind of meat ('Beef, sometimes lamb') and met neighbour Bob Wilson (also studying town planning). Derek offered to show both new students around town tomorrow. After dinner, tired from flying to England and finding Telford Hall, Ahmed unpacked and thought 'So far, so good'.

Part 3 (Exploring Norton & The Lecture): Within one week Ahmed felt at home, strolling along old stone pavements: Mill Street, Silk Street, Canal Street, weaver's Square, Loom Hill... In their Wednesday lecture on Norton's development ('As part of their town planning curse,' [printed typo for 'course']), the lecturer explained coal discovery in the late 18th century changed Norton from an agricultural market town to an industrial centre; small water-powered hill factories closed as town factories opened. He gave them questionnaires to investigate those old factories out in the country.

Part 4 (Buying a car): To reach the countryside, Ahmed bargained with a car salesman and bought a ten-year-old black London taxi in good condition (which he had wanted ever since seeing a London TV programme); next day he and Bob drove into the country.
Discussion: 1 What have you learned from the story about England and English student life? 2 How is life in England different from life in your own country?

interactive_spot.label: خريطة الشخصيات والأماكن والانفعالات في الحلقة 1

simple_explain.html:
• الشخصيات: أحمد حسن الحضرمي (طالب تخطيط عمراني لـ3 سنوات) · بوب ويلسون (زميل في نفس التخصص) · ديريك باركر (سنة ثانية هندسة) · السيدة دايل (موظفة استقبال ذات شعر فضي).
  • تدرّج المشاعر (WB 3 D): من الحزن على المطر الرمادي ← التوتر عند الوصول والقلق من نوع اللحم في Shepherd's pie ← الامتنان لديريك ← السرور بالتأقلم في نورتون ← البهجة البالغة بشراء التاكسي اللندني الأسود.

example.html: Industrial shift clue (WB 3 C #7): agricultural market town → coal discovered nearby (late 18th century) → water-powered hill factories closed and steam/coal town factories opened.

Shepherd's pie.ar: فطيرة الراعي (لحم بقر/غنم وبصل مغطى ببطاطس مهروسة)

feel at home.ar: يشعر بالألفة والارتياح وكأنه في بيته

activities.prompt_ar: أكمل الجمل الثماني بما يعلّل أحداث الحلقة الأولى (WB ص 84–85):

items.question: 1 Ahmed would probably stay in England for three years because ______
items.model_answer: he had come to Norton College to do a three-year course in town planning.

items.question: 2 Mrs Dale must be quite old because ______
items.explain_ar: الشعر الفضي يدل على تقدم السن.

items.question: 3 Ahmed didn't unpack immediately he arrived because ______
items.model_answer: dinner was in five minutes (Derek said 'See you at dinner in five minutes').
items.explain_ar: تأجل تفريغ الحقائب إلى ما بعد العشاء.

items.question: 4 Derek offered to show Ahmed and Bob the town because ______
items.model_answer: they were both new to Norton.

items.question: 5 Ahmed was tired at the end of his first day at Telford Hall because ______
items.model_answer: he had flown all the way to England, travelled by train, found Telford Hall, met Derek, Bob and Mrs Dale, and it had been a long day.

items.question: 6 Ahmed and Bob became friends because ______
items.model_answer: they sat beside each other at dinner, were both new and were both doing town planning.

items.question: 7 The water-powered factories in the hills closed because ______
items.model_answer: coal was discovered nearby at the end of the 18th century and new coal-powered factories opened in the town.
items.explain_ar: الانتقال إلى الطاقة الفحمية في وسط المدينة الصناعية.

items.question: 8 Ahmed bought a car because ______
items.model_answer: they needed to drive out into the country for their assignment on old factories (and he had always wanted a black London taxi).

hints: أجب بجمل سببية واضحة بعد because استناداً إلى PB ص 53.

activities.prompt_literal: D Ahmed experienced many different feelings in his first week in England. Find a point in the story when he felt... (1 delighted: when he bought the taxi.)
activities.prompt_ar: اربط كل شعور من المشاعر 2–6 بالموقف الدال عليه في القصة (WB ص 85):

items.question: 2 depressed
items.model_answer: when he looked out of the train window at the grey sky and streams of rain running down the glass.

items.question: 3 grateful
items.model_answer: when Derek helped him with his heavy suitcases and offered to show him and Bob round Norton.

items.question: 4 nervous
items.model_answer: when he arrived alone at Telford Hall (15 minutes to go, dragging two heavy suitcases) or hesitated before asking about the meat in Shepherd's pie.

items.question: 5 pleased
items.model_answer: after dinner thinking 'So far, so good', when Bob turned out to be studying town planning too, and after one week feeling at home in Norton.

items.question: 6 worried
items.model_answer: when he frowned looking at the unfamiliar dish ('What kind of meat?' — worried it might not be beef/lamb) or heard they had to get out into the country ('Now I have to buy a car').
items.explain_ar: القلق بشأن الطعام الحلال وتكليف الخروج للريف.

hints: موقف 1 محلول مسبقاً في الكتاب: delighted — when he bought the taxi.

questions.stem: In PB page 53 (WB Arts 3 C #7), why did the small water-powered factories in the hills around Norton close?

options.text: Because coal was discovered nearby at the end of the 18th century and new factories opened in the town.
Because Ahmed and Bob finished their questionnaires and bought a London taxi.
options.why_wrong: تلك المصانع أغلقت تاريخياً في أواخر القرن الثامن عشر قبل مجيء أحمد بقرنين.

options.text: Because nobody in Norton knew how to make shepherd's pie.
options.why_wrong: فطيرة الراعي وجبة في مطعم السكن الجامعي ولا صلة لها بالمصانع.

options.text: Because the rain flooded all streets like Loom Hill.
options.why_wrong: تحوّل المدينة كان بسبب اكتشاف الفحم لا المطر.

hints: اقرأ جزء محاضرة الأربعاء حول تاريخ نورتون.
questions.explain: اكتشاف الفحم حوّل نورتون من بلدة سوق زراعية إلى مركز صناعي في المدينة، فتوقفت طواحين الماء الجبلية.

questions.stem: Why did Ahmed frown and ask Derek 'What kind of meat?' at dinner in Telford Hall?

options.text: He wanted to check the meat in Shepherd's pie was beef or lamb (halal/permissible), not pork.

options.why_wrong: سؤاله انصب تحديداً على نوع اللحم: 'What kind of meat?'.

options.text: He wanted Mrs Dale to unpack his suitcases.
options.why_wrong: السيدة دايل موظفة الاستقبال وقد ساعده ديريك في الحقائب قبل العشاء.

options.text: He wanted to drive his black taxi to the dining room.
options.why_wrong: لم يشترِ التاكسي إلا لاحقاً بعد محاضرة يوم الأربعاء.

hints: أجابه بوب ويلسون مطمئناً: 'Beef, sometimes lamb'.
questions.explain: كمسلم قادم إلى بريطانيا لأول مرة، يتحقق أحمد من نوع اللحم في الطبق المجهول قبل تناوله.
